dispositions.input: copy-webpack-plugin 11 cache keys and css-minimizer-webpack-plugin 5 worker options in the docs build

dispositions.input: @rollup/plugin-node-resolve's own frozen defaults; @svgr/plugin-svgo declares the package but never imports it

dispositions.reason: glob 7.2.3 is outside the advisory's affected range (>=9.0.0 <=14.0.1): glob 7 has neither the signal option nor the walker.ts abort branches. npm attaches the leaf advisory to every node of its glob entry.

dispositions.input: @npmcli/map-workspaces, @npmcli/package-json and unified-engine walks in the docs lint tooling
dispositions.reason: The bypass only matters to a caller that relies on signal or AbortSignal.timeout() to bound a walk. None of these callers passes a signal (no signal option in their glob calls); their walks run to completion by design.
dispositions.action: The fix is glob 14.0.2, a major outside the consumers' ^10 ranges; move with the docs lint chain, reassess if a caller starts passing a signal.

dispositions.input: @electron/asar 3.4.1 packing the application's own files during electron-builder packaging
dispositions.reason: The amplification is in firstPhasePreProcess(), which minimatch runs only at optimizationLevel >= 2. This release predates optimization levels and contains no firstPhasePreProcess; npm's affected range (<11.0.1) is wider than the defective code.
dispositions.action: Code absent in this major; move to minimatch >=11.0.1 when the consumer allows it, reassess if this copy changes major.

dispositions.input: x64ArchFiles, infoPlistsToIgnore and asar allow-list patterns from the repository's electron-builder configuration
dispositions.reason: firstPhasePreProcess() runs only at optimizationLevel >= 2. Every caller of this copy uses minimatch()/new Minimatch() with the default level 1 (no optimizationLevel option in its dist), so the amplification code is never entered; the patterns are repository-owned in any case.
dispositions.action: The fix is minimatch 11.0.1, a major outside the consumer's declared range; move when the consumer allows it, reassess if a caller sets optimizationLevel >= 2 or takes patterns from untrusted input.
